text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 2, "unit": "pieces", "kind": "count", "span": "Eric has two pieces of rope"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 10, "unit": "inches", "kind": "length", "span": "One piece is 10 inches longer than the other"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 40, "unit": "inches", "kind": "length", "span": "The total length of the two pieces is 40 inches"}], "plan": [{"op": "sub", "args": ["q3", "q2"], "out": "s1", "note": "remove the extra length of the longer piece, leaving two shorter-piece lengths"}, {"op": "div", "args": ["s1", "q1"], "out": "s2", "note": "split that evenly between the two pieces to get the shorter piece's length"}], "target": {"kind": "length", "scope": "the length in inches of the shorter piece of rope"}, "dismissed": []}
